messages:
nina: hey all — quick onboarding problem. My company laptop got held up in customs and i have a short window this week to run an internal compliance scan on a customer dataset. Can i use my personal laptop if we apply strict controls (no clipboard, no file downloads, screened SSO)? Also worried about failing phishsim while im in this limited setup. :grimacing:

jamal: thanks for flagging, nina. Short answer: personal devices are not allowed to access regulated customer data. We cant approve clipboard/blocking at the OS level reliably for BYOD. Options: 1) A locked-down VDI/VDI-in-cloud with no local drive mount, disabled clipboard, and restricted egress; 2) an air-gapped on-prem lab machine (requires more lead time). If we go VDI well enable endpoint monitoring, session recording, and ephemeral credentials. Phishsim: mandatory, but onboarding cohort can be moved one week.

nina: ok good to know. VDI sounds fine. Can we also block copy/paste and printing? Id like to avoid any accidental exfil.

ops: we can create a disposable VDI with the following controls: no local mounts, clipboard disabled, no printing, network egress only to allowed staging hosts, and sysmon/agent telemetry. It will use SAML SSO + short-lived vault creds. ETA ~4h once manager approval is in the ticket. Tell us if you need Docker or GPU.

people-ops: for the ticket please paste manager approval and this snippet so we can fast-track ordering/provisioning:
```
Manager: @alberto (approved for temporary VDI)
Request: disposable VDI (no local mounts, clipboard disabled, no printing), staging-only network, sysmon agent
Window: 3 days (or until company laptop arrives)
Phishsim: shift cohort by 1 week for onboarding
```
We can also expedite a YubiKey order if the contractor needs one.

nina: manager just confirmed — pasted approval into the ticket. I dont need GPU, just Docker and Python toolchain.

security-bot: Ticket created: #INC-50112 — "VDI for onboarding/regulatory scan (nina)". Status: triage. Assignee: ops. Required: manager approval (attached). Controls checklist: clipboard-disabled, no-local-mount, sysmon, ephemeral-creds.

ops: saw the approval, provisioning VDI now. Ill DM the connection + one-line runbook (ssh + jump or remote desktop). Well enforce disabling clipboard/printing and block S3 download permissions from that session.

people-ops: phishsim cohort moved per manager approval. Please complete the security training on any device, but only use the VDI to access the customer dataset. Well mark this as an onboarding exception in the HR record. :lock: :white_check_mark:

nina: thank you — really appreciate the quick turnaround. Ill wait for the VDI details and finish the training today."
